summary.en: Review inference performance, cost and supply signals after NVIDIA GTC ends on March 18.
summary.zh: 英伟达 GTC 于 3 月 18 日闭幕后，复核推理性能、成本与供给信号。

summary.en: Recheck hyperscaler capex, cloud profitability and cash flow after the first calendar-quarter reporting window. May 15 includes an editorial buffer beyond the usual 40-day SEC deadline for accelerated filers.
summary.zh: 一季度披露窗口过后，复核云厂商资本开支、云业务利润和现金流。5 月 15 日是在 SEC 对加速申报企业通常适用的 40 天期限外留出的编辑部缓冲。

method.en: Weighted mean of the two checkpoint timestamps. Equal editorial weights reflect no verified reason to give either track more weight. This is a review date, not a crash forecast.
method.zh: 综合时点＝技术观察时点 × 技术权重 ＋ 经济观察时点 × 经济权重。暂无足够证据给任一轨更高权重，初始各占一半。这是复盘时点，不是崩盘预测。

label.zh: 美国证交会｜10-Q 季报时限

note.en: Started with an end-of-2027 editorial scenario checkpoint.
note.zh: 首次设置倒计时：以 2027 年年末为情景观察点。

note.en: Moved to a checkpoint after NVIDIA GTC and the annual guidance cycle.
note.zh: 将观察点提前到英伟达 GTC 闭幕后，结合大厂年度指引复盘。

note.en: Replaced the fixed date with a 50/50 technical and economic weighted checkpoint.
note.zh: 从固定观察点改为技术面、经济面各占 50% 的加权观察点。

note.en: Published the calculation and revision history. Dates now use the browser’s time zone; the target instant did not change.
note.zh: 公开计算公式和变更历史，日期改按浏览器时区显示，目标时刻不变。
